# ScribeCat 0.25.0

- Fix PDF zoom anchoring so pinch/trackpad zoom stays centered on the pointer.
- Open the PDF zoom slider automatically when pinch/trackpad zoom begins.
- Restore selectable PDF text at 100% zoom.
- Add mouse/touch panning and a viewport minimap while zoomed.
- Add inline Word .docx preview.
- Add PowerPoint .pptx single-slide preview with slide navigation.
- Add inline video playback with native controls.
- Accept the new media formats from picker, paste and drop flows.

Compare: v0.24.10...v0.25.0
